title: Pollutant - Weather Analysis in Chicago

description.content: This project investigates the relationship between weather conditions and nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) pollution levels in Chicago. By integrating data from the City of Chicago's Open Data Portal and the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), the analysis explores how factors such as air temperature, wind speed, and humidity influence NO₂ concentrations. The project employs data cleaning, integration, statistical analysis, and visualization techniques to uncover patterns and correlations, providing insights that could inform environmental and public health strategies.

dataSources.name: City of Chicago Open Data Portal
dataSources.description: Provides hourly weather data from Beach Weather Stations Automated Sensors in Chicago.

dataSources.name: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Air Quality System
dataSources.description: Offers daily air quality data focusing on nitrogen dioxide (NO₂) levels across different sites near Chicago.

methods: Data cleaning and preprocessing using Python's Pandas library
